cases.title: A ROTATE Copy of pit P3 dropped on the loose end of a pipe still joins that pipe end, with no 'sits on pipe ends' line
cases.plan_item: BUG-1227 Part A guard (a): copy onto a loose pipe end still joins it (pre-review E item 3.4.6)
cases.expected: After SETUP-R47 (P3 moved up 2000, new pit P8 and a new pipe from P8 to the empty point 170000,-80000), ROTATE Copy of P3 by 180 degrees about 111888.85,-51784.95 puts one new pit block at 170000,-80000 (within 1 mm) with a CE line that one pit was copied and numbered as new; the copy's label reads P11; the CE log says the new pipe now runs from=P8 to=P11 (the loose end joined the copy); no 'sits on pipe ends already joined' line prints. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The loose end joins the copy in the live copy relink when AutoCAD ends the native ROTATE command; the switch is read from the real settings file at start.
not_automated: DERIVED: the copy is numbered P11 because SETUP-R47 already used P8 and DRV1_B1 has P9 and P10 (R19 and R34 numbering); the pipe's From is P8 because CD started at P8. If the copy is numbered otherwise, the label check fails first and the join line must be read from the recorded log.
The pipe's own link (Inspector) is not read; the join is proven by the CE log line only.
